name: Nasiruddin Patwary
role: Students Against Discrimination coordinator, Jatiya Nagorik Committee convener, and National Citizen Party chief coordinator
contribution: He is associated with Students Against Discrimination's coordination network during July-August 2024. After the uprising, he became convener of the Jatiya Nagorik Committee and later chief coordinator of the National Citizen Party.
context: Students Against Discrimination, the distributed coordination structures of the July-August 2024 movement, the Jatiya Nagorik Committee, and the post-uprising National Citizen Party.
impact: His profile links the protest coordination network to later attempts to turn uprising-era civic organization into formal youth-led politics and state-reform advocacy.
highlight: A 2024 movement coordinator who later became Jatiya Nagorik Committee convener and National Citizen Party chief coordinator.
seoDescription: Profile of Nasiruddin Patwary, tracing links to the 2024 Anti-Discrimination Movement, Jatiya Nagorik Committee, National Citizen Party, and transition politics.
shortAnswer: Nasiruddin Patwary is linked to the 2024 Anti-Discrimination Movement as a coordinator and to post-uprising politics as Jatiya Nagorik Committee convener and National Citizen Party chief coordinator.

faq.question: How is Nasiruddin Patwary connected to the 2024 Anti-Discrimination Movement?
faq.answer: Nasiruddin Patwary is connected to the 2024 movement through Students Against Discrimination's coordination network and through the post-uprising Jatiya Nagorik Committee, where he was reported as convener in September 2024.

faq.question: What role did he take after the uprising?
faq.answer: After the uprising, Patwary moved into formal political organization: he was reported as convener of the Jatiya Nagorik Committee and, in February 2025, as chief coordinator of the newly launched National Citizen Party.
